metadata.description: Agent Skills by Shishir Agrawal. Each one is a separate plugin, so install only what you need.

plugins.name: sell-my-stuff
plugins.description: Find what you own from email receipts and sell it on eBay and Vinted (UK), from pricing and listings to postage and buyer issues.

plugins.name: uk-personal-tax
plugins.description: UK Self Assessment, PAYE refunds, leaving the UK, foreign income, crypto, RSUs and Overseas Workday Relief, with a tested calculator.

plugins.name: india-income-tax
plugins.description: File and e-verify an Indian ITR, especially as an NRI: residency, ITR form, AIS reconciliation, capital gains, DTAA and Form 67, missed deadlines.
